scope: Read-only source inspection, JSON reading and small-file hashing. No runner/import/--help/AST/version/Lean/compiler/export/kernel/network execution. No frozen input or counter modified.

blocking_finding.problem: Runner self hash is checked once in preflight against gate.runner_sha256, but the runner file is never added to self.immutable. finish only rehashes self.immutable, so an on-disk runner change after preflight is not rejected, despite the macro010 direct-input before/after hash contract.
blocking_finding.minimal_versioned_fix: Keep original package frozen. In a NEW runner revision, after the existing self-hash equality, call self.file_pin(Path(__file__).resolve(), gate['runner_sha256'], remember=True). Re-freeze runner/manifest/gate SHA; no logic or source changes required.
blocking_finding.scope: This is an evidence/integrity contract gap, not proof of an actual mutation or wrong compiled result.

checks.retained_handle: Popen is retained on self.proc; memory() casts int(proc._handle) into wintypes.HANDLE with argtypes [HANDLE,c_void_p,DWORD] and BOOL restype. DWORD header plus9 c_size_t counters match 64-bit Windows PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX layout. No OpenProcess-by-PID or name enumeration.
checks.kill: stop_owned_child only calls this Popen.poll/kill/wait. No taskkill, process-name kill, tree kill or stale numeric PID handle reopen. Risk of tool forcibly terminating its parent is not converted into a successful receipt.
checks.memory: Initial,30s and after-wait samples query cumulative PeakWorkingSetSize/PeakPagefileUsage. >=7GiB sets resource_limited and prevents success even if child0. Final query failure leaves final_memory_observed false and fails closed. Sampling is not a hard cgroup cap.
checks.deadline: One t0/deadline before preflight covers direct hashes/copies/compile/output hashes/final immutable checks/evidence hashes. Cleanup may exceed deadline only on failure. Internal elapsed precedes terminal serialization/fsync; README and outer template correctly require root actual original outer0 plus same-clock total<=3200, so internal success alone is insufficient.
checks.source_and_gate: Disabled template pins v8 5424212b.../1829382, draft manifest7f4496 and independent reviewdc3adb; root must create a NEW enabled gate with exact runnerSHA/current exclusive ownership record. GateSHA and root ownership recent<=300s are checked. A gate proposal is not execution authorization.
checks.fresh_artifacts: Fixed work path and permanent owner marker are exclusive. Source is byte-copied into new source/Solution/Candidate.lean, three outputs use new output/Solution/Candidate.{olean,ilean,c} and must be nonempty after actual child wait0. There is no automatic retry or repair.
checks.old_Candidate_exclusion: Only new trusted-lib plus exact10 prior package-overlay paths enter LEAN_PATH; old fullchain-v2/lib and new output directory are not included. Package paths are checked against old Candidate/trusted paths. Prior Candidate artifact is neither copied nor imported.
checks.trusted_reuse: Only ChallengeDeps/CandidateSpec exact source+terminal+olean SHA are reused; both small artifacts copied to new trusted-lib. Lean/Python exe hashes are checked. Original SDK/DLL/package closure is historical trusted reuse, expressly authorized by a new gate, not a new17GB audit.
checks.execution_scope: One native Lean process with fixed-j1/-M6500/-o/-i/-c/--json, no --setup and no claim to official Linux8GB cgroup equivalence. No exporter/CoreAudit/Nano stage exists.
checks.receipts: started.json,child.json,memory journal/logs and terminal are exclusive writes with flush/fsync. stdout prints terminal SHA. Actual child exit is from retained wait; parent exit field is expressly an intent, externally observed exit remains null. Root original handle is required independently.

nonblocking_requirements: Root must enforce actual outer0 and same-clock total<=3200 after terminal fsync/printing; do not accept internal compiler_resource_gate_passed alone.
Root should retain enabled gate, current process ownership observation and original tool terminal result; this static review does not enable execution.
